highlights.reason_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 从受控预览变为付费 API 可调用，长时程 agent 的成功率、漂移和真实成本现在可以直接测量。
highlights.reason_en: Gemini 4 Argon moves from controlled preview to a callable paid API, making long-horizon agent success, drift and real cost directly measurable.

highlights.reason_zh: Maia 300 展示 Microsoft 的整机架推理能效路线，但生产部署要到 2027 年，当前只能 WATCH。
highlights.reason_en: Maia 300 shows Microsoft's rack-scale inference-efficiency direction, but production deployments start in 2027, keeping it at WATCH.

highlights.reason_zh: ColGrep-Agent 提供可本地运行的代码库搜索模型和 Codex 集成，适合验证是否真能提升补丁成功率并降低总成本。
highlights.reason_en: ColGrep-Agent provides a local repository-search model and Codex integration suitable for testing whether it improves patch success and total cost.

highlights.reason_zh: MiniCPM-V 4.7 公开 35B-A3B 端侧多模态权重；真实手机上的质量、持续速度、温度和耗电需要一起验证。
highlights.reason_en: MiniCPM-V 4.7 opens a 35B-A3B on-device multimodal model; quality, sustained speed, thermals and battery use need joint validation on real phones.

highlights.reason_zh: 加密能力后门论文证明能力引出式审计存在最坏情况盲区，但小型人为实验不能外推成现有模型事故。
highlights.reason_en: The encrypted-capability paper proves a worst-case blind spot in elicitation audits, while its small synthetic experiment does not establish a deployed-model incident.

coverage_zh: 36/36 个固定入口均抓取成功并读完，并补充模型、开发工具、开源、研究、基础设施、政策和非英语一手材料检索。Maia 300、ColGrep-Agent 与 GLM-Legal 只有日期精度；厂商性能仍待独立验证。Grok 4.7、MiniCPM-V 4.7 与加密能力后门论文按 late discovery 补录。召回审计还把 4 个高热度但证据不足的项目登记为 IGNORE。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were captured and reviewed, supplemented by active searches across models, developer tools, open source, research, infrastructure, policy and non-English primary sources. Maia 300, ColGrep-Agent and GLM-Legal have date-only precision, and vendor performance claims still need independent validation. Grok 4.7, MiniCPM-V 4.7 and the encrypted-capability paper are late discoveries. Recall also records four high-attention, under-evidenced projects as IGNORE.
